name: invoice-extractor
description: AI-Based Invoice Extraction System — upload invoices, OCR extracts fields, NLP parses data, search and export

scripts.dev:concurrently: concurrently "npm run dev:ocr" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix client && npm run format --prefix server
